lines.en: Osako, who must now distract herself from the idea of being tied up and teased by her girlfriend later tonight, exits the apartment by my side and leads me down the stairs.
Just like she said, it’s not a far walk as I can already make out the light of the convenience store from around the corner.
: Can’t really say I expected to find myself out with you of all people on my anniversary.
: Hey, you’re the one who invited me. I was more than willing to go home.
: I know, I know.
: It’s just...
: It’s the first time Wakana’s ever gone out of her way to contact anyone who isn’t me, I think.
: Normally she’s just all like-
: Why would I expel the energy necessary to call someone when I have absolutely nothing to gain from doing so?
: Wakana would say that? No way.
: That’s impossible.
: It was just a little weird, you know?
: Like, I’m glad that she finally has a friend and whatnot, but it’s just..uncharted territory, I guess.
: We’re not particularly close or anything, if that’s what you’re worried about.
: I normally wait until a person’s significant other is in space before I think about making a move on them.
: And even then it’s a sort of case by case basis.
: Is that supposed to make me feel more comfortable about this?
: If you’re uncomfortable as it stands, isn’t that on you in the first place?
: Of course it is. It’s just...
: I’m totally in love with Wakana and, despite her tendency to repeat the same thing over and over and over, she’s always been a little unpredictable.
: Like she doesn’t completely understand how other peoples’ feelings work. Myself included.
: But she tries for me, at least. And I love that about her just like I love everything else.
: Shit, what am I even saying right now? You don’t want to hear about this.
: I don’t...not want to hear about it either.
: You said you had something to talk to me about, so I figured through context clues that it would just be you ranting about how much you love goth girls for a few minutes or something.
: Not just any goth girls, dick. Wakana specifically.
: Frankly, I’m still surprised she even settled for me in the first place considering that my style is essentially the polar opposite of hers.
: You’re both cute in your own ways.
: Stop calling me cute or I’ll break your kneecaps.
: I’m sorry.
: Can I still call your girlfriend cute, though? Or is that off limits too?
: You can call her whatever you want so long as you don’t try to make any actual moves on her.
: You’re not afraid she’d actually go along with it, are you? Because she clearly likes you a lot if she’s going to ask people for help just to try and cook something for you.
: I like to think that too.
: But...I don’t know.
: Even though we tell each other we love one another all the time, she still feels weirdly distant on occasion.
: And, it’s probably self-explanatory due to the whole karate thing, but I have a tendency to be a little...defensive, I guess.
: Not just with myself but with anything I want to protect.
: And I swore back in college that I’d protect her for the rest of my life, even if she didn’t want me to.
: So, if she never accepted your confession, you’d just...stalk her every hour of every day and defend her from anyone who tried to get close?
: Yeah...probably...I don’t know.
: Well, that’s not creepy at all.
: I can’t help it, okay?!
: Wakana’s not like a normal person! She’s like a...scared little puppy that you need to be really gentle and careful with if you ever want her to warm up to you!
: I mean, I never had to do that.
: That’s...exactly why I feel so weird about all of this.
: And a big part of why I wanted to talk to you.
: For some reason, Wakana warmed up to you almost right away.
: Way quicker than she did with me and the two of us are in an actual relationship now.
: So I can’t help but overthink that since it’s just...a brand new thing I’ve never had to deal with.
: I’m not going to steal your girlfriend, Osako.
Probably.
Especially since I’d likely die the second I tried anything.
: It’s not just the actual act of you “stealing” her. It’s a...fear I have that maybe she’ll realize that she wants something else.
: And that we’ll revert to being friends or something if she starts thinking that things aren’t as good as they could be with a different person.
: I’m going to be honest, you were the last person I thought I’d have to coach some self-esteem back into.
: I’m going to be honest too and say that you’re the last person I thought I’d ever have to talk to about this.
: Just being strong physically doesn’t make me strong as a person, you know. I’m actually annoyingly sensitive when it comes to stuff like this.
: Wakana’s the tough one. But I think a lot of that is just because she doesn’t really see the world the same way most other people do.
We’ve already made it to the convenience store, but have yet to set foot inside and disturb the employees with our decently personal conversation.
A conversation I had a feeling was going to be inevitable from the moment I got Wakana’s phone number.
I’m not entirely used to engaging in relationships with people whose significant others are not missing, so at least I can be glad this is happening now rather than later.
Preferably, I’d like if it wouldn’t happen at all.
But not even my life can be as convenient as that.
: I have a question for you.
: You do? About Wakana?
: More or less.
: My question is...if you really do care about her, shouldn’t you want her to figure out whether what she truly wants is you or not?
: I do. But that doesn’t mean I’m not going to worry about it as well.
: She’s everything to me. And the thought of that changing is just...
: Let me clarify that I don’t think you need to worry about that.
: I haven’t known Wakana for long, but the things she said about you today made me realize that she’s so into you that she wouldn’t even consider romance with someone else.
: Consideration doesn’t really have anything to do with it.
: Wakana’s not as...calculated as she might make it seem. She’s actually pretty neurotic and impulsive at times.
: She can think one thing but then do something else. And things like that aren’t always easy to suppress, which is why I’ve always kept a close eye on her.
: Well...I kept a close eye on her even before I knew that because...holy shit, she’s so hot.
: But yeah.
: I guess I just think everything right now is a little too good to be true.
: And that one day she’ll snap out of what’s been such a happy dream for me and move onto bigger and better things.
: I don't know.
: Sorry for springing this on you out of nowhere. I’m just really afraid of losing her and...I guess I wanted you to know that?
: Why are you wording that like a question?
: Probably because I still don’t understand why I wanted you to know that when you’re already fucking Ayane.
: I’m-
: You totally are.
: You don’t-
: Don’t even try to deny it. It’s so obvious.
Damnit, Ayane.
Why must your love for me be so powerful?
: I’m also a little mad that you got to see Wakana in an apron. I wanted that to just be a me thing.
: She looked surprisingly...homely for a woman who would likely have trouble microwaving instant ramen.
: And on that note, we should probably head inside so we’re not out here looking like we actually enjoy each other’s company.
: Wait...are both of you tsundere?
: Hm? Wakana, maybe a little bit.
: But you’d absolutely know if I had any feelings for you. I make very little effort to actually hide them.
: This hurts me.
: Well, sorry to hurt ya even more, but that weird banana shaped muscle you’re already sharing with Ayane would be a no-go for me in the first place.
: So it’s not just me, it’s men in general.
: That somehow makes me feel a little bit better.
: It’s also kinda you.
: You’re fine to talk to...but even if I did like dudes, you're too much of a wimp.
: Okay, time to shop.
Osako and I enter the convenience store and I can immediately tell just how often she does this.
She moves through the narrow aisles with surgical precision, placing ingredients neatly into a basket that she grabbed just beyond the store’s automatic doors.
There’s little to no conversation on the inside, which I imagine is due to the fact that we last left off on the...sheer concept of penises.
But, at the same time, I feel like Osako has already said everything she wanted to say in the first place.
She’s madly in love with Wakana Watabe. This much is entirely irrefutable.
In fact, even if the two of them wound up breaking up, I can see Osako sitting quietly on a porch somewhere, growing old and withering away while thoughts of Wakana still dance around in her head.
I wonder if I’ll ever be able to feel that way about anyone.
And then I think about all of the people who feel that way about me.
It ruins my night.
: Okay! Now we’re ready to make actual soup that isn’t filled with Jell-O.
: Oh, am I coming back with you?
: Nope! By “we” I meant Wakana and I.
: Wakana and me.
: Fuck off. Only Wakana can correct I.
: Now you’re just fucking with me on purpose.
: Damn right me am.
: Thank you, though.
: Not just for hearing me out, but for being a friend to the girl I love more than anything else in the world.
: And remember...if you do try anything, I know of seven different pressure points on your body that could kill you instantaneously.
: There is no way that’s true.
: Play your cards right and you’ll never have the displeasure of finding out!
: It’s terrifying how you can smile like that while threatening to kill me.
: If it’s to protect my cute little fallen angel, I can do anything.
: You mean anything except feeling totally comfortable with her associating with someone of the opposite sex because you’re afraid she’ll suddenly discover how awesome she thinks penises are.
: Okay, now you’re just being an asshole.
: I’m always an asshole. You just don’t have enough experience with me to realize that.
: I have even more experience with you than Wakana does. I’ve been giving you karate lessons for like...I don’t even know how long now.
: Correction- you’ve been trying to give me karate lessons.
: You have yet to succeed.
: Oh yeah? Looks like I might have to try a little harder next time, then.
: Hope you’re ready to feel sore all over for the next year.
: What are you going to do to me?
: Hm. Maybe reveal one of those seven pressure points?
: If I delete Wakana’s number from my phone, will you allow me to keep my life?
: You don’t have to stop talking to her or anything, dude.
: Just...keep in mind that she’s everything to me. And that without her I’d be absolutely nothing.
: Sounds good.
: Anyway, enjoy getting tied up and edged tonight.
: I will, thank you very much!
: And I hope you enjoy sexting one of your students!
: I don’t really do that. I much prefer actual physical-
: Die!
: I mean...bye!
: Go away!
Osako storms off in the opposite direction with a shopping bag pressed firmly between a set of fingers that will likely wind up inside a coworker of mine tonight.
I contemplate whether or not this “sexting” thing is truly worth it-
But then realize that I have a perfectly good lesbian fantasy to continue playing out in my head as soon as I get home.
Osako’s affection has increased to [osako_love]!
